title: Q6 v4: orchestrator/planner_shadow.py + .mcp.planner-shadow.json — non-mutating Opus shadow Planner launches, structured result parsing, agreement scoring (P6)
spec:
Why: the brief (P6) requires shadow mode where Fable stays the production Planner and an Opus shadow decision is recorded without any production effect. goals.launch_planner (goals.py:322-353) and planner_runs.launch_routed give the headless Planner the full MCP surface (.mcp.planner.json: orchestrator, bus, github) and all tools, so a shadow launch through them could mutate the bus, plan.md or git. Spec reviews of T-0722 and T-0724 folded in: escalated key, sample semantics, action priority chain, dict-based account access. The Planner waived a further spec review.
What: new module orchestrator/planner_shadow.py and new file .mcp.planner-shadow.json whose content is a JSON object with an empty mcpServers map. The prompt template .orchestrator/prompts/planner-shadow.md already exists on goal/T-0674 and has one placeholder named packet; render it with spawn.render("planner-shadow", packet=text). Do not edit any prompt file.
- RouterDecision comes from orchestrator/planner_router.py (merged): fields tier, mode, hard, hold, hold_reason, reasons, hard_reasons, soft_score, shadow_tier, candidates, evidence, decision_type; cfg is planner_router.load_cfg(pool_cfg) with key shadow_sample_rate. planner_telemetry.materiality (merged) returns {material, new_tasks, dependencies_changed, fix_strategy_for, escalated, plan_changed}.
- eligible(router_decision, cfg, *, sample=None) -> (bool, reason): checks in order mode_not_shadow (mode != "shadow"), held (hold True), no_shadow_tier (shadow_tier None; covers hard decisions and the router's own sampling, which already nulls shadow_tier when its draw exceeded shadow_sample_rate), sampled_out (only when sample is not None and sample > cfg["shadow_sample_rate"]; the caller passes the router's own draw, so this is a defensive re-check and the docstring says so), else (True, "eligible").
- argv(prompt, *, model, budget_usd, system_prompt_path) -> list: ["claude", "-p", prompt, "--model", model, "--output-format", "json", "--max-budget-usd", str(budget_usd), "--mcp-config", ".mcp.planner-shadow.json", "--strict-mcp-config", "--disallowedTools", "Edit,Write,MultiEdit,NotebookEdit,Bash,Task,WebFetch,WebSearch", "--append-system-prompt", text of system_prompt_path (the caller passes .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md), "--dangerously-skip-permissions"]; no bus/orchestrator MCP server, no write tools.
- launch(prompt, *, model, account, budget_usd, log, root=ROOT, popen=None) -> {"pid", "log", "stderr_log", "argv"} or None on any exception (message to stderr, never raised; the production launch must not be affected). account is the plain dict from pool.toml [[claude_accounts]] exactly as goals.launch_planner uses it: env CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR = os.path.expanduser(account["config_dir"]), ORCH_ROOT, ORCH_SHADOW=1, and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from os.environ[account.get("oauth_token_env")] when that variable is set; never resolve [secrets.planner] (a shadow has no GitHub or Jev access). popen defaults to goals.Popen so tests inject a fake; start_new_session=True; stdout to log, stderr to log + ".stderr". Budget: the caller passes [limits].max_budget_usd.planner_shadow (default 1.5).
- parse(log_path) -> dict or None: last JSON line of the log, take its "result" text, spawn.extract_json (orchestrator/spawn.py:646) it, whitelist keys proposed_action (one of fix_round, respec, escalate, noop, synthesize_now, wait_for_more, drop_low_confidence, write_specs, close, other; anything else -> other), summary (cap 800 chars, jev.redact applied), tasks_proposed (list of {title (cap 120), scope (list cap 10)} cap 10), confidence (float clamped 0-1 or None), needs_fable (bool), unresolved (list of str cap 10, each cap 200); plus usage via bus.normalize_usage("claude", usage), total_cost_usd, session_id, is_error. Anything else dropped; a missing/non-JSON result -> {"parse_error": True, plus the usage fields}; unreadable log -> None.
- record(*, launch_id, goal_id, decision_type, state_version, model, tier, started_at, parsed, latency_s, root=None) -> row appended to root/runs/sched/planner_shadow.jsonl (write the file directly like planner_telemetry does; no schedlog global swap) without prompt text.
- production_action(materiality) -> str: explicit priority chain, first match wins: "escalate" when escalated is True; "fix_round" when fix_strategy_for non-empty; "write_specs" when new_tasks non-empty; "noop" otherwise. score(shadow_row, production_materiality) -> {"agreement": True|False|None, "basis", "needs_fable_matched": True|False|None}: agreement = shadow proposed_action == production_action, with shadow synthesize_now counted equal to write_specs; None when production_materiality is None or the shadow row has parse_error; basis names both actions. needs_fable_matched = (bool(shadow needs_fable) == bool(production_materiality["escalated"])) when the key "escalated" is present, else None.
- summary(root=None) -> {"n", "agreement_rate", "needs_fable_rate", "parse_error_rate", "usd", "tokens"} tolerant of malformed lines.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_argv_has_no_bus_mcp_and_no_write_tools — argv uses .mcp.planner-shadow.json (whose file content has an empty mcpServers map), --strict-mcp-config, a --disallowedTools list containing Edit, Write and Bash, the shadow model, and never .mcp.planner.json

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_launch_failure_is_isolated_and_production_unchanged — a popen that raises makes launch return None without raising; with a dict account the env carries the expanded config_dir, ORCH_SHADOW=1 and no secrets.planner values; the bus tasks directory and plan.md hash are identical before and after a successful fake launch

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_parse_whitelists_and_caps — a log whose result JSON has proposed_action fix_round, a 3000-char summary, 15 tasks and an extra transcript key parses to summary 800 chars, 10 tasks, no transcript; a non-JSON result gives parse_error True with usage still read

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_score_priority_chain_and_needs_fable_matched — production_action gives escalate when escalated and fix_strategy_for are both set, fix_round when only fix_strategy_for, write_specs when only new_tasks, noop otherwise; shadow synthesize_now vs write_specs agrees; missing materiality gives agreement None; needs_fable True with escalated True gives needs_fable_matched True, with escalated False gives False, without the key gives None

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_eligible_and_summary — eligible gives mode_not_shadow, held, no_shadow_tier for the matching RouterDecision inputs, sampled_out only when an explicit sample exceeds shadow_sample_rate, and True with sample None for a shadow decision; summary over three rows including one malformed line reports n and rates without raising

constraints.interface_contract: eligible(router_decision, cfg, *, sample=None) -> (bool, reason); argv(prompt, *, model, budget_usd, system_prompt_path) -> list; launch(prompt, *, model, account (dict from [[claude_accounts]]), budget_usd, log, root, popen) -> {pid, log, stderr_log, argv}|None; parse(log_path) -> whitelisted dict|None; record(*, launch_id, goal_id, decision_type, state_version, model, tier, started_at, parsed, latency_s, root) -> row in runs/sched/planner_shadow.jsonl; production_action(materiality) -> escalate|fix_round|write_specs|noop; score(shadow_row, production_materiality) -> {agreement, basis, needs_fable_matched}; summary(root). Wave B calls eligible/launch/parse/record/score from planner_runs.run_group and reconcile.

result.summary:
Implemented isolated shadow launches, bounded result parsing, agreement scoring, and summary telemetry.
Gate: passed, 967 tests. Failures-only output: empty.
Commit: `c2261172db2f1c4b342d933cfdcbd35c90ff7aaf`. Worktree clean.
